defective_pattern: Generating Word document tables with <w:insideV> vertical borders and outputting decimal values missing Persian leading zeros.
why_defective: Vertical borders violate strict APA 7 three-line formatting rules. Missing Persian leading zeros violates standard Persian typography norms.
observed_symptoms: Word document table contains <w:insideV> vertical borders.
Decimals lack Persian leading zeros (e.g., .05 instead of ۰.۰۵) in markdown and docx.
corrective_remedy: Suppress <w:insideV> tags in docx generation to strictly conform to APA 7 guidelines. Apply a regex or string replacement pass to convert all English decimals to Persian numbers with leading zeros before writing to disk.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Deterministic regex pattern matching the defect
